tasks.title: Dead + Live Load Calculation
tasks.submission: Python script or structured JSON math array.
tasks.assignment: Calculate the dead and live loads for a commercial floor plan based on standard IS/IBC codes.
tasks.ai_review: The AI runs the math. If the calculations exceed the safety-threshold formulas, it flags a structural failure and issues a Fail.

tasks.title: BOQ Data Export
tasks.assignment: Export a Bill of Quantities (BOQ) from Revit or AutoCAD for concrete and steel.
tasks.ai_review: The AI parses the data structure to ensure proper material coding, cost estimation limits, and volume constraints are met.

tasks.title: Smart Bridge Sensor Schema
tasks.assignment: Design the data schema for temperature and stress sensors placed across a smart bridge.
tasks.ai_review: The AI checks whether the schema includes critical tracking fields such as sensor_id, timestamp, stress_value, and battery_level.

curriculum.title: Task 3: IoT Sensor Mapping for Smart Buildings

tasks.title: Emergency SMS Trigger
tasks.assignment: Create a webhook that triggers an emergency SMS if a bridge sensor detects a micro-fracture.
tasks.ai_review: The AI fires a mock critical stress payload at the webhook to ensure it correctly catches the data and returns a 200 OK status.

tasks.title: Smart Building Data Architecture
tasks.assignment: Submit the complete data architecture for a smart building, including load scripts, sensor routing, and an automated energy-saving API.
tasks.ai_review: The AI evaluates the end-to-end logic, ensuring data flows correctly from the simulated physical structure to the cloud dashboard without errors.
